gazetteer.description: Place-centric PLATO serialisation of the DEEP MADS XML (Jisc, 2017 release; mirrored 2026-09-26), county volume Oxfordshire. Generated and schema-validated against PLATO v0.4.0 (release 0.4.0, commit ca0afadabec1e23a145c0b03df77e8f151f79832).
